content: Ked-ampù para te Pengalang te Megbevayà

content.text: He Nengazen, ebpengumew-umew a kenikew, ne segugunà a tevangi.
Pemineǥa nu heini is kebpengumew-umew ku kenikew.
Isipa nu he iring te veyewà heini is ampù ku ziyà te kenikew.
Isipa nu is kebeyawa ku te menge velad ku he iring kemahal te mahapun he kebpemuhat.
Giyahi nu, Nengazen, is kebpengaǥikaǥi ku su wey a kenà mekekagi te mezaat.
Ilikey a te kebpekevaal te mezaat wey te kedtampu te ebeelan te menge lalung.
Ilikey a te kebpekivahin te ǥastu zan.
Mezawat ku is kedawey wey kedsawey kedì te metazeng he etew;
kenè ku haazà mevelivezi su iyan idhimuwa zin dutun is tenged te ǥaǥew zin wey keupiya zin kedì.
Iyan, is menge lalung mulà layun ku id-ampù he kenà medlampus is mezaat he menge vaal zan.
Emun ibpenimbag en diyà te pangpang is menge edumala kandan, ebpeketuu zan he tutuu is menge lalag ku.
Ne zutun egkaǥi zan te, “Ebpekedsusuwey en bes is menge tulan tew ziyà te edlevengan kenitew ne egkeiring heini te menge vatu he ebpemekeǥawas ke egkeeradu.”
Umbe, Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ, diyan e zà edsarig;
umbe kenè nu ituǥut he egkepatey a.
Ilikey a kenikew zuen te menge penuǥes te lalung he menge etew he idhingutel zan kedì.
Himuwa nu he iyan sikandan meutel zuen te penuǥes dan, ne mekelikey a mulà dutun.
